summary: Several subjects draw on one budget. Each member's local cap is not enough: the total is enforced by one coordinator through reservation, commitment, release and reconciliation on every path that can spend.

coordinator.description: Reference of the contract or service that holds reservations.

partialOrder.rule: B is not wider than A when B.denomination == A.denomination, B.totalCap <= A.totalCap, B.coordinator == A.coordinator and B.members is a subset of A.members. A member binding derived from a group binding keeps the group's totalCap and coordinator unchanged.

verification.resultMeaning: the request was reserved against the total before it could execute
trustAssumptions: every spending path routes through the coordinator; paths that do not are declared as bypasses

limitations: Cross-chain or cross-service budgets need a stated consistency model; this profile covers one coordinator on one chain.
